authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, v5.4.1 sections 20.2 and 20.4.9
authority.basis: The R13/R14 no-links bit implies adjacent previous/next handles; INSERT carries a SEQEND only if the attributes bit is set.

independentSourceTrace.limit: Peer trace and independently encoded controls do not prove native behavior or whole-file graph/output closure.

rootCause: The direct INSERT commit overwrote the parsed implicit next handle with null SEQEND + 1 for INSERTs without attributes; the false 0x01 link stopped the block walk.
change: Advance past a legacy SEQEND only if a real SEQEND frame was prepared, the parent uses implicit links, and the SEQEND handle is non-null and does not overflow. Otherwise preserve the parsed next link.

validation.asan: PASS: generated AC1015 INSERT followed by LINE and untouched sentinel; direct R13/R14/R2000 no-SEQEND staging controls; existing staged-attribute and block-delimiter selectors. AddressSanitizer with project warning flags.
validation.sourceReplay: Before: one entity failure and false missing 0x01. After: zero entity failures and 12 independently matched block INSERT handles. Four distinct object failures remain.
validation.transaction: Strict and partial ASCII/Binary exports all refuse and preserve seeded destinations because the four object failures remain. The regression tests preserve the following sentinel; this does not demonstrate successful file output or native readback.

remaining: P6-F remains open: this source has no remaining entity parse failure and still has four object failures. No support claim or output guard is broadened.
